tasks.title: Validate v2.4 migration under load
tasks.description: Re-run the migration dry-run with a synthetic concurrent write workload.

comments.body:
Dry-run data from weekend testing:
- Sample size: ~25 runs
- Timeout rate: ~1 in 5 (~20%)
- Condition: only reproduces under concurrent write load
- Error signature: migration stalls during table-rewrite pass on events table; query times out waiting on row locks
- Hypothesis: missing index on events.workspace_id_idx — without it, the rewrite does a full table scan under concurrent writes, causing lock contention and timeouts
- Gut call: add workspace_id_idx before the rewrite pass and re-run. Migration logic itself looks sound. Needs Kai's sign-off before we commit.
